public_boundary.hidden_metadata: VisibilityEventMetadata reuses existing head and deletion parsing; it carries no application policy

durability.canonical_truth: signed event rows remain authoritative and immutable
durability.mutation: combined SQL triggers atomically advance generation epoch, event last-change epoch and dirty visibility obligation
durability.backfill: fixed initial sequence target with durable sequence cursor
durability.legacy_change_epoch: zero marks source rows predating this index; the fixed initial backfill prepares them without a whole-source UPDATE or payload decode in migration
durability.replay: ordered last-change epoch and source-sequence cursor; updates to previously scanned rows are replayed without resetting the initial cursor
durability.completion: all initial rows and subsequent changed rows prepared at the transaction's active source token
durability.transaction: one bounded immediate transaction; cancellation or failure before commit rolls back metadata and progress
durability.restore: verified whole-file replacement preserves metadata and source together, closes old handles, and requires consumer runtime invalidation separately

semantics: verified unsupported heads retain suppression authority
raw events have no head or deletion authority
only visible authorized deletion requests contribute targets
same-author event and address deletion semantics reuse the reference parser
created_at is stored as ordered unsigned 8-byte big-endian metadata
missing address identifier behavior matches the reference evaluator
no partially prepared index is advertised complete
separate_followup: Indexed visible/status providers and bounded repeated-read qualification remain a separate checkpoint
